PresenterIntent: Derive compatible action presentations from the selected object, action descriptors, and interaction state.
RecognizerIntent: Interpret choosing an action as an action request or transition into argument selection/confirmation.
LoweringRationale: CLIM-style systems make available commands visible and selectable. When an object has a compact reference plus inspection/copy affordances, PBUI should be able to present compatible actions as first-class objects without waiting for a specific target menu or toolbar design. The v1 rule intentionally keys off the currently emitted `copy_reference` and `inspect_subject` actions instead of requiring a separate `select_subject` obligation, because Street Deli domain-specific selection currently appears as actions such as `select_menu_item` rather than a universal selection obligation.
